description: Same-family room, §9.12: the Gemini flash line by generation — 2.5, 3 (the preview slug, the only 3.0 flash served), 3.5, 3.6, 3.7 and 3.8 (released 2026-09-02, the day before this condition). One tier so that generation is the only thing that varies between seats; the Pro models would add a second axis. Gemini 3.7 is the house roster's seat under the same id. Names are the generation only ("Gemini 3.5"), since everyone here is a Flash. Journal on (house baseline); everything else control.
